ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

19. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS

23. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
